extraction_notes: Figures 1 through 4 on p. 2 contain usable plotted traces. Points were digitized from the vector traces at visible axis grid intersections; no intermediate points were synthesized.
The reverse-current curves are plotted as positive magnitudes under reverse bias; their polarity is stated in the curve test conditions.

Tabulated source meanings are preserved: forward voltage is typical, reverse leakage and capacitance are maximums, reverse recovery is a maximum, and the reverse breakdown voltage is a minimum at the stated test current.
The forward characteristic table supplies one typical point at IF = 0.1 A; additional forward points are available only from the plotted typical curves.
